newsitem.title: USA: BGE shuts Calvert Cliffs nuke unit for repairs.
newsitem.headline: BGE shuts Calvert Cliffs nuke unit for repairs.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co shut the 850 megawatt (MW) Calvert Cliffs 1 nuclear power station to repair a reactor coolant system leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
The NRC, in its daily plant status report, said the unit is tentatively expected to restart June 1.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the unscheduled outage.
Calvert Cliffs 1 nuclear power station, in Lusby, Maryland, had been operating at full power Thursday.
The facility's adjacent unit 2 was operating at 93 percent of its 850 MW rated capacity while its undergoes testing of its moderator temperature coefficient.
The Calvert Cliffs facility is wholly owned by Baltimore Gas and Electric.
